about: The fixed vocabulary for annotating mined reference posts (SOP/attribution/mine-reference-recipes.md). Every annotation uses these values; free text goes only in the fields marked free. Add a value here, in its own commit, before a batch uses it - never inside an annotation.

contentType.lookbook_editorial: a styled shoot of one or more looks, same set or a few sets
contentType.product_showcase: the garment itself is the subject: flat lay, hanger, mannequin, detail cards
contentType.multi_outfit_lineup: several distinct outfits, one per slide, as a collection round-up
contentType.photo_dump: a casual mix of selfies, places, food and friends around one day or trip
contentType.outfit_check: a person showing today's outfit, mirror or wall, little styling of the set
contentType.selfie_closeup: face-led selfies or close portraits, the outfit barely visible
contentType.magazine_tearsheet: magazine pages, covers or printed features
contentType.event_group: stage, event, or group photos of several people
contentType.beauty_product: cosmetics or skincare held or shown

framing.detail_macro: fabric, trim, button, lace filling the frame
framing.garment_only: garment on hanger, mannequin or held, no worn shot

pose.weight_shift: standing, weight on one leg, hip or knee relaxed
pose.lean_wall: leaning on a wall, door frame or pillar
pose.sit_chair: seated on a chair, stool or bench
pose.sit_floor: seated on the floor or a rug, legs folded or to the side
pose.recline: lying back or reclining on a sofa, bed, fabric or floor
pose.hand_face: hand or fingers at cheek, chin, lips or temple
pose.hand_hair: touching or tucking hair, hand on head
pose.hold_prop: holding flowers, cup, bag, book or another prop
pose.peace_sign: peace sign or playful hand gesture
pose.leg_kick: one leg kicked back or lifted
pose.twirl_motion: turning, twirling, hair or skirt in motion
pose.arms_raised: arms up, stretching or framing the face

setting.studio_floral_set: studio set dressed with flowers, drapery, oversized bows
setting.window_light_room: bright room led by window light and sheer curtains
setting.street_night: city at night, lit windows, neon
setting.rooftop_view: high floor or rooftop with a city view

mood.seasonal_holiday: a season or holiday drives the look

gridRole.standalone: reads on its own in the profile grid
gridRole.row_theme: part of a row of three that shares a set, colour or look
gridRole.mosaic_piece: one tile of a larger picture split across several posts
gridRole.colour_block: part of a run that alternates or blocks colours across the grid
gridRole.unknown: cannot tell from the grid sheet

textOverlay.small_logo: a small brand mark or handle
textOverlay.title_text: headline or caption text on the picture
